description: List bank transactions (Umsätze) of the payment accounts. Amounts are signed: positive = incoming, negative = outgoing (direction in/out). Filter by account id, date range, direction and status: created (offen, not yet booked), linked (verknüpft), private, auto_booked, booked (gebucht). Unbooked = status created. Status, direction and value-date ranges are checked here while reading up to 5000 rows per call; dateField=entry lets sevDesk filter by entry date instead (faster). offset/nextOffset count sevDesk rows, not matches: pass nextOffset while hasMore is true. Account ids: sevdesk_bank_accounts_list. Use detail=summary to browse/find. Use sevdesk_transaction_get for assignments and the amount still unassigned.

dateField.description: Date that from/to apply to: value (Wertstellung, default; filtered here) or entry (the second date, see entryDate; sevDesk filters it itself).

detail.description: Use summary to browse/find; full (default) or the matching get tool for details.

from.description: First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD (Berlin time).

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging: pass the previous result's nextOffset.

status.description: Statuses to include, e.g. ['created'] for unbooked transactions.

to.description: Last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD (Berlin time).

name: sevdesk_transactions_list
title: List sevDesk bank transactions
